'''Shor''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] that was inhabited by the [[Near-Human]] [[Shorak]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Shor was located near to the world [[Giaca]] and about one hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Jedi Civil War]], [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] from Shor discovered Giaca. A number of expeditions were subsequently lauched from Shor to explore Giaca, but after [[Peroenian]] military forces attacked the Shorak colonists on Giaca, a war broke out between Shor and the planet [[Peroenia]].<ref name="TUR" />
